annotations.title: Pick the best photos from a shoot

description: Drop the blurred photos and near duplicates from a set of photos (media ids from media_list) before making a collage or carousel: of each group of look-alikes the sharpest stays. Answers kept (in the order given) and dropped, each with a reason (blurred, or duplicate of another id). Pass keep to also cap how many stay (the sharpest keep ones; the rest come back as trimmed). Photos nobody measured yet are measured in the background and come back as pending: ask again a moment later and they are included. Your photos are not changed; pass kept to stills_options.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
